consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: secondary containment by bund and drainage
controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels
integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.title: injury during transfer operations on P-7113

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels on P-7113, PT-7113 and TK-7104 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in managing hydrocarbon transfer and storage, specifically bunding, drainage and spill containment. P-7113 (export transfer pumps) is in service for tank-to-jetty product transfer, same seal class as the Marrindal family. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 4 January 2024 an incident occurred on P-7113, PT-7113 and TK-7104 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during transfer operations, releasing pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator.
